scene: The sound board unlocks a transit map, powering three waiting city routes.
picture: Along a level line, an illuminated moving walkway platform sits on the far left. The silver-haired boy in a mint hoodie and headphones stands centre-left, facing a humming mixer console in the centre. Up high, a glass karaoke elevator waits open. On the right, a river hover ferry docks at a neon jetty.
shown: a glowing moving walkway ramp idling silently on the far left
a sleek docked river hover ferry bobbing quietly on the right
a glowing glass karaoke lift door waiting wide open up high
